AND prw.product_line_id in
#{productLineId}
AND prw.start_time >= #{start} AND prw.end_time <= #{end} GROUP BY prw.produce_order_id, ppo.production_line_id, ppo.material_id, prw.classes_id

SELECT prw.product_line_id, prw.station_id, prw.start_time as start, prw.end_time as end, prw.id as reportWorkId, ppo.material_id, prw.classes_id FROM pms_report_work prw JOIN pms_produce_order ppo ON prw.produce_order_id = ppo.id WHERE prw.start_time >= #{start} AND prw.start_time <= #{end}

#{lineId}
